plan: Represent adaptation as pure construction: build new dicts/lists from the input recipe (Fractions are immutable), guaranteeing adapt() and print_original() never mutate arguments.
Scale all quantities once by factor = target_yield / recipe yield at chain entry; additional ingredients from substitutions are authored at original yield and pass through the same entry point.

Resolve exclusions with a per-ingredient while-loop that re-checks the current name against the excluded set, enabling chained substitutions to a fixed point; a per-chain visited-name set detects cycles (reason: 'substitution cycle involving NAME').
Select catalog choices deterministically by sorting candidates on the key (priority, catalog index); record chosen IDs in order in `choices`.

Accumulate impossibility reasons in a shared set and keep processing all ingredients, components, and the equipment check, so the reasons list contains every independently applicable reason, returned sorted with recipe=null.

Route component resolution through a pluggable reason sink: mandatory components write into the global reason set, optional components write into a throwaway set and are dropped with a sorted warning instead of failing the adaptation.

Apply wording_changes by string replacement across the working copy of the instruction list; apply add_equipment/remove_equipment to a working equipment set, checked against available_equipment after all substitutions and emitted sorted.
Compensate substitution yield_factor with a global post-multiplier applied to all final quantities so the adapted recipe is always exactly at target_yield (with a warning).

Ship an executable acceptance suite under __main__ covering: 3→5 scaling, chained substitution, verb+equipment-changing substitution, reintroduced-exclusion detection, multiple simultaneous impossibility reasons, byte-for-byte original printing with input-mutation check, and priority/tie-break determinism.
mechanisms: fixed-point substitution loop per ingredient (re-check new name against exclusions)
per-chain visited-name set for cycle detection
(priority, catalog-index) sort key for deterministic catalog choice
global reason-set accumulation for exhaustive independent impossibility reporting
pluggable reason sink so optional components degrade to a warning instead of a failure
single scale factor applied at chain entry; additional ingredients share the same entry point
global yield_factor compensation multiplier keeping the result at target yield
copy-on-build construction (no input mutation); authored_text passed through untouched for byte-exact printing
string-replacement wording edits over a working instruction list; working equipment set validated post-substitution and emitted sorted
